reasonableness.draft_prompt: A cute clay fairy-tale winter farm scene, farmer holding a lamb in snow. Soft claymation style like the reference.
reasonableness.revised_prompt: A brand-new winter farm snowfield scene in fairy-garden clay fairytale style (lock medium only from the style reference; do NOT copy that garden layout, mole character, petal house, creek, mushroom table, or giant tropical leaves). Mid shot, slight high angle looking down a snowy farmyard. Center: a round clay Q-version farmer (about 2.5 heads tall) standing in soft white clay snow, arms cradling a small fluffy clay lamb against the chest; lamb body rests in both hands with clear contact; farmer looks gently down at the lamb. Farmer: short rounded limbs, soft bean-like torso, rosy cheeks, large irises with specular highlights (no black-dot pupils), simple knit winter hat and scarf in warm cream and berry pink. Lamb: rounded clay wool clumps, tiny legs tucked, pink nose, iris eyes with highlights. Snow reads as smooth matte white polymer clay with soft AO contact shadows under boots and hooves, not crystalline ice. Background: one small rounded clay barn with soft doughy wood texture and a single arched door, a few clay fence posts, pastel winter sky with candy-soft peach and lavender; sparse rounded clay evergreen shrubs, no tropical foliage. Lighting: soft high-key studio glow with gentle ambient occlusion, warm bounce from snow, no harsh contrast, no neon. Materials: smooth matte clay / soft-plastic rounded edges everywhere, hand-modeled feel, shallow depth of field behind subjects. Palette roles: snow cream white dominant (~70%), barn warm wood and evergreen muted green (~20%), scarf/hat berry pink and soft purple accents (~10%). Commercial miniature fairytale mobile-game finish, clean silhouette, subject filling safe zone. Joints continuous for farmer arms holding the lamb; sheep limbs connect as a sheep, not human elbows. Solid scenic background, no transparency, no text, no watermark.
